latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Generate videos from text or images using a cloud AI render pipeline.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG files up to 200MB; output is 1080p MP4.
- Anonymous authentication with 100 free credits (valid for 7 days); handles session, state, upload, export, and error reporting.
- Simple text prompts power video creation—ideal for content creators, marketers, and students.
- Automatic backend setup and session management; user-friendly handling of uploads, exports, and credits.
- Robust error handling with clear user guidance for common issues (format, file size, credits, export limits).
